import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean(), g[True]-g[False]
e,gg=est(w); print(e); print(gg)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); bs=[]
grp=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  d=pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in grp]); bs.append(est(d)[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in [['high'],['high','medium']]:
  print(dc, est(w[w.date_confidence.isin(dc)])[0])
print('no 1800-1810?', (w.year<1876).sum(), w[w.year<1876].year.value_counts().sort_index().head(20))
print(est(w[(w.year>=1850)&(w.year<1900)])[0])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','size']))
print(w.groupby(['origin','late']).r.mean().unstack())
# author clustering
print(w.author_key.nunique())
